findings.issue: The isEnded filter in endPausedSessions (and the click-time pausedSession read for the confirmed id) runs outside the write transaction. ended() re-reads and re-parses the record but does not check isEnded again. If another tab ends a session between the getAll/click and ended(), ended() would put a new endedAt. Today the reports.add then fails with ConstraintError and the transaction aborts, so nothing changes. The only exposure is an ended record whose report is missing, which would get a new endedAt.
findings.evidence: stored session (other tab / stale read) -> endPausedSessions filter (outside txn) -> ended() put endedAt without isEnded check. Mitigated by the write-once report add aborting the txn.
findings.fix: Optional: in ended(), resolve without writing if isEnded(session) on the in-transaction read.

summary: No BLOCKER/MAJOR. Invalid stored values are skipped (parseSessionRecord in try/continue), and ended() parses them again inside its own transaction, aborting on failure. Ended records and the confirmed id are skipped. Deletion happens only when the in-transaction parsed record has handsPlayed 0, so stale or crafted state cannot steer it into deleting a session with hands. Per-record failures are collected without stopping the loop. The dialog renders the summary as a JSX text child (no innerHTML). No new dependencies, randomness, secrets or network.
